card.name: Partway through condition and symptom phrases
card.fires_on: A word or word part in the middle of a medical phrase, where the next word is expected to continue it, such as 'sick', 'Depleted', 'congest' (ive) or 'side' (effects). It appears in drug-label and health-news text.

modes.label: Symptom or condition words
modes.description: Words naming being ill or a body function, often just before a continuing phrase.

modes.description: Words inside a risk or treatment phrase, such as 'side' before 'effects' or 'receiving' before a drug.
